Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有很多人不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。有很多人吃植物以后就吃坏肚子了，因为他们吃了毒。那个时候，有一个老人叫神农，他什么植物都觉得好吃，不怕生病，不怕毒。他希望别人也可以吃好吃的植物。可是他知道，如果他们还怕吃毒，不会吃他喜欢的植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the sentence about people becoming ill, add a physical detail to show their discomfort, such as “有的人捂着肚子，疼得直冒汗。”
2. After introducing 神农, add his purpose or inner thought to make his character more vivid, such as “他想：我要找出哪些植物能吃。”
3. In the final sentence, add a short line of thought to show why he hopes others will try the plants, such as “他想让大家都不用再吃坏肚子。”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete symptom that fits the people getting sick after eating poisonous plants.
This gives 神农 a fitting goal that matches the traditional tale and the scene.
This clearly expresses his wish to protect people from becoming sick from plants.
